known.title: Not done: GitHub Actions oversubscribes CPU-restricted Python 3.11 runners

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A self-hosted Linux GitHub Actions runner running Forge on Python 3.11 is restricted to four CPUs on a 32-CPU host.
Python 3.11 has no `os.process_cpu_count`, so `cores` falls back to `os.cpu_count()`, which reports the host count rather than the process's affinity limit ([Python documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/os.html#os.cpu_count)). This branch consequently allocates 32 pytest workers to that four-core runner, oversubscribing it and increasing the risk of memory exhaustion. The new test does not catch this: `tests/conftest.py:72-82` injects `os.process_cpu_count` even when the test interpreter is Python 3.11.
